verdict.rationale: The only evidence near bulk action is that one workflow can be attached to one or more links, a single one-to-many configuration action. A REST API exists, but nothing shows bulk or batch endpoints or multi-select actions across many items. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk edit or delete of links/meetings in the UI, AI-driven bulk actions, documentation or hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
